{{icon:database}}

Data and coverage

From official company registries and filings in each country we cover. For India, our current coverage, that means filings with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and Registrar of Companies, statutory charge records and GST registration data.

Companies and LLPs registered in India, including active, struck-off and under-liquidation entities. More countries are planned.

We refresh company data twice a year, in January to March and July to September. Your report shows the data from the most recent refresh, and if a refresh happens during your 12 months of access, you get the updated data automatically. Companies usually file the previous year’s financial statements in time for the January to March refresh.

Reports reflect the latest filings on record. If a company has delayed its statutory filings, your report contains the complete verified data up to its most recent filing. If it files later, the new data is added at the next scheduled refresh, at no extra cost while your 12 months of access last. If a company is newly incorporated and has not completed its first annual filing, we tell you before you spend a credit.

Yes. Listed and unlisted companies both file with the company registry, so both are covered in the same report format.

Figures are taken from the documents the company filed and standardised into one format. We do not change filed figures, so if a filing contains an error, the report shows it as filed.

Yes. Write to support@incoinfo.com with the company name or registration number and we will check whether it can be added.

{{icon:file-text}}

Reports and delivery

12 months of access to the company’s compiled data: multi-year financial statements, directors and shareholding, registered charges, compliance status and related companies. You can download the report as PDF and Excel and the original filings as often as you like, and you get refreshed data whenever a scheduled refresh happens during those 12 months.

Our standard processing time is 7 days. Bulk orders of more than 500 companies take up to 14 days. We compile up to 50 companies a week for each client, depending on workload, and your account panel shows the projected delivery date for each order.

Yes. Sample reports are on the Content page, and the demo shows the full workflow from search to report.

PDF for reading and sharing, and Excel for analysis. Every report uses the same fields and layout, so companies are easy to compare. You can also download the original filings the report is built from.

Up to five years, where the company has filed them.

We refresh data on a fixed schedule twice a year: January to March and July to September. Every client with an active 12-month access period for a company gets the refreshed data automatically. A refresh picks up new financial statements, annual returns, changes in directors and shareholding, new or satisfied charges, and compliance status. Data is not updated between scheduled refreshes. If you need a company updated sooner, you can buy a credit for it again.

Yes, as often as you like during your 12 months of access, without spending another credit.

Plans and credits

One credit gives you 12 months of access to one company’s data, including any scheduled refreshes in that period.

Professional is a single-user plan for individual consultants and analysts. Business, Corporate and Enterprise give 2, 5 and 10 users one account. The calculator on this page shows the lowest cost for the number of companies you need.

Yes. A single company costs ₹599 plus taxes.

Credits are valid for 12 months from the date of purchase. Once a company is unlocked, you have access to its data for 12 months. When you renew, you choose which companies to keep, and only those stay accessible.

No. You buy credits when you need them, and nothing renews or charges automatically.

Yes. Buy another plan at any time and the credits are added to your balance. Each purchase keeps its own 12-month validity.

No. During your 12 months of access you can open and download the company as often as you like. A new credit is needed only to extend access beyond 12 months, or to get the company updated before the next scheduled refresh.

Yes. If you need more than 1,000 companies a year, talk to sales.

Billing and payments

Credit and debit cards, UPI and net banking, processed by our payment partner.

No. Prices exclude taxes, and GST is added at checkout.

Yes. A tax invoice with your company’s GSTIN is available to download from your account.

Yes, for Corporate and Enterprise plans. Please talk to sales to arrange it.

Unused credits can be refunded within 7 days of purchase if none have been used. See the refund policy for details.

Payments are handled by a PCI-DSS compliant payment partner. We do not see or store your card details.

Accounts and users

Yes. You need an account (a login) to search the company database. You can buy a plan whenever you are ready to unlock companies.

Professional is for a single user. Business includes 2 users, Corporate 5 users and Enterprise 10 users, all on one account.

Yes. On team plans, all users draw from one shared credit balance.

Yes. The account administrator can add or remove users at any time.

Yes. Open the demo to see search, ordering and a full company report.

Support and legal

Email support@incoinfo.com. We reply Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST.

Yes. We do not share which companies you search for or unlock, and companies are not told that you looked them up.

We show only the information that appears in public statutory filings. See our privacy policy.

You are buying 12 months of access to the data for use within your organisation, not the data itself. Please do not resell or republish reports. See the terms of service.
